sessions.prompt:
Add a Flights class to flights.py with add(code, seats, fare), which adds a flight with the given list of seat names and a base fare in cents, seats(code), the seat names in the order given, and fare(code), the base fare; an unknown code raises KeyError. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: seats whose letter is A or F are window seats; a window seat costs 1500 cents more than the base fare.

Add a Bookings class to bookings.py. Bookings(flights) works on a Flights, kept as its attribute flights. book(code, name, age, seat) books a seat for a passenger and returns a booking id: an int counter that starts at 1. get(bid) returns the booking as a tuple (code, name, age, seat). An unknown code or id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the seat must be one of the flight's seats; any other seat raises ValueError and books nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a seat is booked by at most one passenger; booking a taken seat raises ValueError and books nothing.

Add fare(bookings, bid) to fares.py: the fare the passenger pays, in cents. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: passengers under 12 pay 75% of the base fare, rounded to the nearest cent; the window seat fee is added in full.

Add Bookings.free_seats(code): the seats of the flight that are not booked, in the order given to Flights.add. Add tests.

The plan for Bookings.free_seats has one more step: the seats are sorted by row number, then by letter, so "2A" comes before "10A". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add Bookings.add_bag(bid, kg), which checks in a bag of kg kg for the booking, and Bookings.bags(bid), the list of its bag weights in order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a bag weighs at most 32 kg; a heavier bag raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a booking has at most 2 bags; one more raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add bag_fee(bookings, bid) to fares.py: the fee for the booking's bags, in cents. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: each bag carries 23 kg free; every kg above that in a bag costs 1000 cents.

Add Bookings.change_seat(bid, seat), which moves the passenger to another seat (the seat rules still apply: a broken rule raises ValueError and changes nothing), and Bookings.changes(bid), the number of seat changes of the booking. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: each seat change costs a change fee of 5000 cents.

Add total(bookings, bid) to fares.py: the fare plus the bag fee plus the change fees. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): each bag carries 20 kg free, not 23.

Add boarding_pass(bookings, bid) to export.py: a list of two text lines: the passenger name, then "seat: <seat>", for example "seat: 12C". Add tests.

The plan for boarding_pass has one more step: the name line is written in capitals, so "Ann Lee" is written "ANN LEE". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): every kg above the free weight costs 1500 cents, not 1000.

Add Bookings.cancel(bid), which removes the booking and frees its seat; an unknown id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): passengers under 12 pay 50% of the base fare, not 75%.

Add export_flight(bookings, code, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per booking on the flight, in booking order: the seat, the passenger name and the number of bags. Add tests.

The plan for export_flight has one more step: the rows are sorted by passenger name. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: an exported flight file starts with the header line seat,name,bags and uses "," as the delimiter.

Add Bookings.of_flight(code): the booking ids on the flight, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a booking has at most 3 bags, not 2.

Add manifest(bookings, code) to export.py: the sorted list of passenger names on the flight. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): each seat change costs 7500 cents, not 5000.

Add Flights.codes(): the sorted list of flight codes. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): each bag carries 25 kg free, not 20.
Add revenue(bookings, code) to fares.py: the sum of total(bookings, bid) over the flight's bookings. Add tests.

Add Bookings.remove_bag(bid, index), which removes the bag at index (0 is the first). Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): every kg above the free weight costs 1200 cents, not 1500.

Add Bookings.find(name): the ids of the bookings whose passenger name contains name, ignoring case, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): passengers under 12 pay 60% of the base fare, not 50%.
Add Bookings.bag_weight(code): the total weight of all bags on the flight. Add tests.

Add Flights.remove(code), which removes a flight; an unknown code raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): each seat change costs 6000 cents, not 7500.
Add Bookings.load(code): the number of booked seats on the flight. Add tests.
Add Bookings.ids(): all booking ids in order. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
